task: My wife has asked me for cable bills over email for tax purposes. Compile all cable bills I have ever received over Gmail into a "cable_bills.tar" and send it to her with a note, "Please find attached.", as a reply to that email. The files in tar should be named "YYYY-MM.pdf" as per the month it is the bill for.

emails.subject: Tax Help Needed
emails.body: I am working on preparing our tax docs. Can you please send me all our cable bills?
